<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="os_sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2a1a12"/>
      <stop offset="0.42" stop-color="#12100f"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#07070a"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="os_dusk" x1="0" y1="1" x2="0" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c4622a" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#8a3f22" stop-opacity="0.16"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a3f22" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <radialGradient id="os_vig" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.75">
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="os_type" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f6e4c2"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#e3c793"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b48f5c"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Emulsion grain. Coarser than the station card: this is a copy of a copy. -->
    <filter id="os_grain" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.7" numOctaves="4" seed="3" result="n">
        <animate attributeName="seed" values="3;19;41;8;3" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </feTurbulence>
      <feColorMatrix in="n" type="saturate" values="0"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.42" intercept="-0.14"/></feComponentTransfer>
    </filter>

    <filter id="os_beacon" x="-300%" y="-300%" width="700%" height="700%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>

    <filter id="os_soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.4" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>

    <pattern id="os_scan" width="3" height="3" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="3" height="1" fill="#000" opacity="0.22"/>
    </pattern>

    <clipPath id="os_frame"><rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#os_frame)">
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#os_sky)"/>
    <rect y="150" width="640" height="210" fill="url(#os_dusk)"/>

    <!-- The Basin at night: a low, mostly dark skyline with a few windows that still draw. -->
    <g fill="#0a0a0d">
      <path d="M0 286h44v-26h30v26h26v-42h34v42h40v-18h28v18h52v-34h30v34h58v-22h26v22h40v-30h32v30h44v-16h26v16h60v-24h30v24h40v98H0z"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#ffca7a" opacity="0.5">
      <rect x="52" y="268" width="3" height="4"/><rect x="118" y="252" width="3" height="4"/>
      <rect x="212" y="276" width="3" height="4"/><rect x="286" y="244" width="3" height="4"/>
      <rect x="398" y="256" width="3" height="4"/><rect x="470" y="240" width="3" height="4"/>
      <rect x="556" y="262" width="3" height="4">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.15;1" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
    </g>

    <!-- The mast on the ridge. Everything in this picture happened underneath it. -->
    <g stroke="#0c0c10" fill="none" stroke-width="2.4">
      <path d="M556 262 L544 118 M556 262 L568 118 M544 118 L568 118"/>
      <path d="M547 236h18 M549 210h14 M550.5 184h11 M552 158h8 M553 132h6" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <path d="M544 118 L568 118 L562 96 L550 96 Z" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <path d="M528 258 L544 190 M584 258 L568 190" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Beacon: the light that has been blinking without instruction for eleven years. -->
    <circle cx="556" cy="92" r="9" fill="#e2503a" filter="url(#os_beacon)" opacity="0.55">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.12;0.72;0.12" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="556" cy="92" r="2.6" fill="#ff8a6a">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.35;1;0.35" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>

    <!-- Signal going out over a Basin that never licensed it. -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#e2503a" stroke-width="1.1" opacity="0">
      <path d="M556 92 m -30 0 a 30 30 0 0 1 60 0" opacity="0.5">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.5;0" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#e2503a" stroke-width="0.9">
      <path d="M556 92 m -52 0 a 52 52 0 0 1 104 0" opacity="0">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.32;0" dur="2.8s" begin="0.35s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <path d="M556 92 m -76 0 a 76 76 0 0 1 152 0" opacity="0">
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.18;0" dur="2.8s" begin="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
    </g>

    <!-- Title -->
    <g text-anchor="middle" filter="url(#os_soft)">
      <text x="300" y="168" fill="url(#os_type)" font-size="47" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="9.5">THE OPEN SIGNAL</text>
    </g>
    <g text-anchor="middle">
      <path d="M118 186h364" stroke="#8a6b3f" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.65"/>
      <text x="300" y="206" fill="#c2a373" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="6.4">EIGHT YEARS NOBODY OWNED THE AIR</text>
      <text x="300" y="330" fill="#6d5c43" font-size="8.5" letter-spacing="4.2">A MERIDIAN RECLAMATION PICTURE</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Grade, grain, scanlines, matte -->
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#os_vig)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" filter="url(#os_grain)" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#os_scan)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="40" fill="#000"/>
    <rect y="320" width="640" height="40" fill="#000"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#000" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.07;0;0.03;0" dur="4.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
  </g>
</svg>
name: open_signal_logo
